values.note: 29 sites in all (FS). The 2022 FS map shows 9 walk-in tent sites (9-12, 15-17, 20, 21), a host site (13), and 20 drive-in sites, of which 7 and 8 lie past a 'NO RV's OR TRAILERS PAST THIS POINT' sign; the 18 counted are 1-6, 14, 18, 19 and 22-30. FS gives parking spurs of 15 to 65 ft; the forest's status table gives Max Spur 40'. Vehicles must fit the spur.

note: Roosevelt NF campground at ~6,600 ft in the Poudre Canyon off paved CO-14, about 25 mi from US-287; the Cache la Poudre River runs between its two halves (sites 22-30 sit across a bridge on the far bank). Open conifer forest with riparian growth along the river. --Claude
summary: FS page, FS map and the ARP status table: confirmed FCFS, $30, vault toilets, potable water. Changed sites 29 -> 18 (drive-in sites open to RVs: map shows 9 walk-ins, a host site and 2 car-only sites past a no-RV sign); added max spur 40 (status table; FS page says 15-65), pull_through false, season 05-15..09-20 (status table). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Missing phone: Canyon Lakes Ranger District Office 970-295-6600 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/offices).

Sites: FS text says 'four walk-in tent sites', but the FS map (Sept 2022) marks nine walk-ins (9-12, 15-17, 20, 21). It also posts 'NO RV's OR TRAILERS PAST THIS POINT' before drive-in sites 7 and 8. Counted 18 drive-in sites a 23-ft rig can use; per-site lengths are not published, so some of those may be short (spurs 'range from 15 to 65 feet').
Max length conflict: status table 'Max Spur 40'' vs FS page 'parking length ranges from 15 to 65 feet'. Recorded 40.

Waterfront (stored riverfront), re-audit lead: FS calls it 'adjacent to ... the Cache La Poudre River', and the river runs through the middle. On the FS map the 22-30 loop road follows the river's far bank with spurs pointing away from it; sites 4-6 spur toward the river with a belt of riparian conifers between (Esri imagery); the closest pads look 20-40 m from the water. Clouds cover part of the NW half, so no open apron was confirmed. The Poudre here measures roughly 25-30 m bank to bank on imagery, at the river/creek size line.
Operator: concessionaire-run (FS map: 'managed by a concessionaire under a special use permit'). Ownership federal stands. No recreation.gov campground record (241116 returns 404; POI only).
Status: FS page 'Site Closed' (season over). The ARP status table's road row lists Kelly Flats FS 168 'OPEN 5/15 - 11/20'. No Cameron Peak Fire closure applies to it (unlike Jacks Gulch).
Pin 40.6807,-105.4825 = the FS page coordinate, at the CO-14 entrance by the east half. OK.
